text:
[Council File 25-1210]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the acceptance of grant funding from the California Department of Education under the California State Preschool Program Fiscal Year 2026-27 Local Agreement for Child Development Services Contract No. CSPP-6167 for subsidized preschool services at Department of Recreation and Parks’ licensed preschools.
(This item is referred to the Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee and Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item forthwith (Dec 12, 2025); Council action final
